### 2026-10-16 – # Starting Work On My Very Own Marble Run!

**2.02h**

# Starting Work On My Very Own Marble Run!

Today, I finally had enough time to start working on my week two project! I was waiting for this day **all week**, and I'm excited to see what I end up making!

![download](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/58bf1c71bfced9b959b70eea4955f55ec33dfdfd3d8d13ce8eb29fbfd6e0c32c.jpg)

# Starting My Session
I started by choosing Merbl run, the starting project for week two. I could have done my own project, but I wanted to learn new CAD tools! I went through the guide, but I was able to skip a few steps, since I have done alot of Onsahpe before for FRC.

![images](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/7045c203e851291c7eec72372f4801154c462540aaafc6bf389c1f59c3bd85a2.png)
Ma team

[Guide](https://docs.github.com)

# During
I went through the instructions pretty fast, but I soon quickly realized that this was not what I learned for FRC. It did take some time; I ended up trying a lot of the strategies today, and I was even able to figure out how to make a spiral!

![image](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/CSRBTfO1gnf3OnVHBGadYvTR5GkJjHAY/d8ee57502e0309d04d8e970cf795ab91bfb4c6807d8f0bd907b7daf683221c58.png)

After a lot of testing, tomorrow I'm going to design my Marble Run before I start CADding, so I have something to base it on instead of random things everywhere.
